'''Alise Davros''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. She fled Emperor [[Arcann]]'s oppression into the [[Endless Swamp]] where she joined the [[Zakuulan rebels]] led by [[Pashna Veyaad]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alise Davros sends her message only if the rebels were denied training in the Dark Side option. In this case she takes over after [[Pashna Veyaad]] was killed and thanks the Alliance for the weapons, but reveals that untrained rebels are quickly being picked off by [[skytrooper]]s and that she expects to die fighting.
